question: Which of the following has the chemical name as sodium hydrogen carbonate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baking soda**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The chemical name of Baking Soda is **Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate(NaHCO₃).**

 
 
• Baking soda is also known as **cooking soda**.
 
• Its appears a fine powder form.
 
• It has a slightly **salty**, alkaline taste resembling that of **washing soda (sodium carbonate)**.
 
 
 
• **Calcium Hydroxide**:-
 
 
• Calcium hydroxide is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula Ca(OH)₂.
 
 
 
• **Sodium Carbonate**:-
 
 
• Sodium carbonate, Na2CO3, (also known as washing soda, soda ash and soda crystals) is the inorganic compound with the formula Na2CO3.
